text:
Mn1's gate is connected to sn2 when it should be connected to n0. Every other stage drives its NMOS gate from the previous stage's output, the same node as its PMOS gate. With Mn1 wired this way, stage 1 is no longer an inverter, so the 7-stage ring loses its inversion and cannot oscillate. That fits the near-zero swing, f = n/a, and the tiny sensitivities.
